question_verbatim: Is copper worth committing new capital to through the three-month contract at today's price? (INVENTED FIXTURE)

requirements.description: Is the subject earning more than a year ago? (INVENTED FIXTURE)
requirements.gap_reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - the subject is a metal, not a business; the equity fact families are absent by design
requirements.weakened_test: profit growth cannot anchor conviction; the asset class's own anchors carry the case

requirements.description: How much cash does the subject generate after unavoidable spending? (INVENTED FIXTURE)
requirements.gap_reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - there is no business inside the metal; no cash generation exists to measure
requirements.weakened_test: the cash-generation leg of the case is empty; the class anchors stand in for it

requirements.description: Is the price expensive or cheap against the subject's own history or peers? (INVENTED FIXTURE)
requirements.gap_reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - no earnings rating exists for a metal; the curve and the inventories carry the read instead
requirements.weakened_test: price against its own history is the only rating-like read, and it is weaker than an earnings rating

requirements.description: Does the earnings or cash yield beat the risk-free rate? (INVENTED FIXTURE)
requirements.gap_reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - the metal pays nothing and costs carry; the curve prices that, and there is no yield to compare
requirements.weakened_test: the comparison against the risk-free rate is one-sided by design; the cost of waiting in bills is the whole reading
